texts.error.data_could_not_be_read: The game's files inside the core could not be read.
texts.error.out_of_memory: The core ran out of memory.
texts.error.setting_resolution_is_it: The setting resolution is %1. It goes from 1 to %2.
texts.error.zip_could_not_be_read: %1 could not be read as a zip.
texts.property.clock: The machine's date and time, in seconds since 1970 (UTC): the start time setting plus the steps taken
texts.property.collectibles: The rings (the engine calls them collectibles)
texts.property.in_level: 1 while a level is being played
texts.property.player_gsp: The player's speed along the ground, in pixels a step
texts.property.player_x: The player's horizontal position, in pixels
texts.property.player_xsp: The player's horizontal speed, in pixels a step
texts.property.player_y: The player's vertical position, in pixels (it grows downwards)
texts.property.player_ysp: The player's vertical speed, in pixels a step
texts.property.steps: Steps the machine has taken, at 60 a second
texts.setting.language.about: The name of a language file of the game ("english", "german"); empty for the game's own choice. It changes the texts the game shows, so it is part of the machine, and a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.quality.about: The engine's video quality. Low draws with a depth buffer and no water effects; high draws the most. It changes the picture, and the engine's water effects with it, so it is part of the machine and a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.quest.about: A quest (a list of levels) to start in, such as "quests/default.qst"; empty for the game's menu. A level to start in (the setting above) is used first. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.resolution.about: The picture is 426 by 240 pixels times this number (1 to 4). Drawing is slow, so 1 is best for most uses. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.startlevel.about: A level to start in, such as "levels/sunshine-1.lev" (the first level of Surge the Rabbit); empty for the game's menu. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.starttime.about: The date and time the game believes it is when it starts (UTC). The game's clock runs from it, one sixtieth of a second a step, and its random numbers start from it. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.game.help: A game made with the Open Surge Engine, as a zip of its folder (the folder with its surge.cfg). Without it the project plays Surge the Rabbit, whose files are in the core.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The files an earlier play wrote (preferences and saves), as the zip that Game > Export Save Data writes. The game starts with them.
